## Gap Analysis regarding Chilli, Tomato, and Coconut

*(This section must be tied directly to the 15 papers you insert above.)*

- **Gap 1**: None of the 15 papers above successfully calibrate a capacitive sensor for *high-variance soft leaves* (Tomato/Chilli) AND *thick/waxy fronds* (Coconut) simultaneously.
- **Gap 2**: Papers [X] and [Y] from the matrix above operate strictly in temperature-controlled greenhouses or use bare copper electrodes that corrode in real-world humidity, showing a gap in field-weathered conformal deployments.
